subject: Payout holdback: reseller entity allocation + evidence request
messages:
From: ResellerOne <payments@resellerone.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Solutions <billing@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payout holdback: reseller entity allocation + evidence request

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Hope you're both well. We're processing the May settlement for Acme Cloud Solutions but have placed a temporary hold on the payout associated with SKU group ACME-ML-001. Finance is requesting verification of entity mapping and proof of taxes withheld at source for March–May activity prior to release.

To expedite, please provide the following by EOD Thu (US):
- Redwood entity mapping for Acme account (entity tax IDs + invoice routing)
- Seller contract extract showing payment routing to ResellerOne (if available)
- Proof of any withholding tax or local VAT applied (pdf/statement)

Attachments included: settlement summary (ResellerOne_settlement_Q1.csv) and an initial note (proof_of_withholding.pdf).

If we don't receive evidence, the hold will remain and the funds will be staged per marketplace policy. Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Claire Martin
Head of Payments, ResellerOne
attachments: ResellerOne_settlement_Q1.csv (csv), proof_of_withholding.pdf (pdf)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payout holdback: reseller entity allocation + evidence request

Marissa / Vanessa —

Looping you in. ResellerOne placed a hold on Acme's payout pending entity & withholding evidence. Initial quick triage: 
- I can produce the entity mapping export from billing (redwood_entity_mapping_2027Q1.xlsx).
- Need procurement/partner copy of the reseller contract; Marissa, can you pull the signed schedule that shows payment routing?
- Vanessa, could you confirm if our tax team has recorded any withholding for the Acme → ResellerOne flows in March–May?

Proposed owner/steps: 
1) Marissa: export contract excerpt and any DocuSign link (today)
2) Vanessa: tax ledger confirmation and any proof-of-withholding file (tomorrow morning APAC)
3) I'll reply to ResellerOne with a single bundle and ask AWS Marketplace to confirm the specific ledger line they flagged (to ensure we don't miss an entity split)

If any of you see risk that additional refunds/credits will be needed, flag it now so we can budget reserves.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor | Strategic Finance, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0182
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: ResellerOne <payments@resellerone.io>, AWS Marketplace Billing <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 07:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payout holdback: reseller entity allocation + evidence request

Claire / AWS team —

Thanks for the heads-up. We're assembling the requested evidence and aim to deliver a consolidated package by EOD Tue (US). Preliminary notes: 
- Attached is our entity mapping export for the Acme account (redwood_entity_mapping_2027Q1.xlsx) — it shows the customer was billed under Redwood Entity RWI-US-01 with invoices routed to the Redwood payments team.
- Marissa is retrieving the reseller agreement excerpt confirming ResellerOne as the payment routing partner and any DocuSign reference.
- Vanessa is checking the tax ledger to confirm whether Redwood recorded withholding or if the withholding flag came from reseller-side reporting.

Two clarifying asks to help us target the exact ledger item: 
1) Can AWS Marketplace confirm the marketplace transaction ID(s) or the usage IDs (the 'usage_id' column on their settlement export) that triggered the hold? A match will let us reconcile quickly.
2) If the hold is related to multi-entity billing (customer usage split across two merchant entities), please indicate which entity ID AWS has associated with the held tokens.

We'll attach the contract excerpt and any proof-of-withholding once retrieved. If there's a short window to call, I can be available 11:00–12:00 PDT today.

Regards,
Grace
attachments: redwood_entity_mapping_2027Q1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: ResellerOne <payments@resellerone.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Solutions <billing@acmecloud.com>, AWS Marketplace Billing <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payout holdback: reseller entity allocation + evidence request

Grace —

Thanks for the quick response and the mapping file — that helps. Attached are the CSV of the Q1 settlement lines we flagged and a short PDF from our compliance team showing the withholding certificate we received from the local tax authority (proof_of_withholding.pdf).

Key notes: 
- The hold was triggered because several lines in the settlement referenced an entity ID we don't have on-file for Redwood (merchant_id: RWI-EU-02). The CSV highlights three usage_id lines (usage-9876, usage-9882, usage-9919) that were auto-flagged by our ingestion rules.
- ResellerOne has applied a local withholding of 7% in-country per their reseller contract and submitted a certificate — we included that doc.

Please confirm receipt and whether the RWI-EU-02 mapping is intentional (was this an upstream customer entity split?). If so, Marissa/Grace, we'll need the signed amendment that routes funds to RWI-EU-02 or a re-crediting instruction that routes funds back to RWI-US-01.

Claire Martin
Head of Payments, ResellerOne
attachments: ResellerOne_settlement_Q1.csv (csv), proof_of_withholding.pdf (pdf)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: ResellerOne <payments@resellerone.io>, Acme Cloud Solutions <billing@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payout holdback: reseller entity allocation + evidence request

Claire / Acme —

Received the CSV and withholding cert — thank you. Quick summary of our internal reconciliation: 
- The RWI-EU-02 merchant_id is a legacy billing entity used for specific EU trials in Q1; it was not intended for production flows for Acme. We did not have the amendment on-file authorizing ResellerOne to route Acme funds to RWI-EU-02.
- Action we are taking: 
  1) Marissa has pulled the executed contract and a DocuSign trail that confirms the contract uses RWI-US-01. (Marissa: please attach the DocuSign ID to the HubSpot ticket HS-2093847.)
  2) Vanessa confirmed Redwood did NOT record withholding for these lines — withholding appears to have been applied by ResellerOne at payout.
  3) We request ResellerOne issue a re-credit for usage-9876, usage-9882, usage-9919 back to RWI-US-01. Once re-credit is initiated and ResellerOne confirms, we'll instruct AWS to release the hold.

Next steps & timeline: 
- Marissa: upload contract excerpt and DocuSign ID to the shared drive (by EOD).
- Vanessa: generate a short exception memo for finance explaining the policy gap (tomorrow).
- Claire: please confirm the re-credit instruction and provide an expected settlement date. If you need an internal letter from Redwood acknowledging the mistake on the merchant_id, we'll provide it.

We'll keep the HubSpot ticket updated and open a short billing-change request to block RWI-EU-02 for future Acme flows. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor | Strategic Finance, Redwood Inference
